children.text: CSS Test: Vertical Position of Floats

The big coloured boxes should be level with the top of the small
  coloured boxes of the same color (unless there is not enough room
  for the big box to fit on the small box's line, in which

case the
  big box should be level with the bottom of the respective small
  box).
